product.olivetti-m40.summary: The departmental Linea 1 system could add storage cabinets.
product.olivetti-m40.history: Olivetti announced Linea 1 in 1982. The M40 covered business, technical computing and data processing. The M44 retained its cabinet and the option of external cabinets.
product.olivetti-m40.architecture: The modular cabinet supported different capacities. The Prato specimen has a 4 MHz Z8001, 256 KB of RAM, an 8″ floppy drive and an 18 MB disk.
product.olivetti-m40.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
